name: Evogliptin

examples.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of DA-1229 (Evogliptin) in Patient's Calcific Aortic Valve Disease With Mild to Moderate Aortic…
examples.why: The study is terminated due to sponsor's business decision. There were no safety issues influencing this course of action.

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Evogliptin low scores for heart and liver concerns [M]. Across three searched clinical studies, only one study example was provided [3][4]. That single study was stopped early because of a company business decision rather than any safety problems [4].
